channels.C1:
Dear Ms. Köhler,

Thank you for contacting our firm. We have opened a matter for your dispute with your landlord over the withheld lease deposit. Our team will now prepare a demand letter on your behalf.

If we need any more details, we will contact you directly. In the meantime, please send us any documents you have that relate to the deposit. Helpful items include the lease agreement, receipts or proof of the deposit payment, move-in and move-out records or photos, and any written communication with the landlord.

Kind regards,
[Firm Name]
